description: This file defines the Zend_Translate class, which manages translation adapters and their configuration within the Zend Framework. It includes constants for adapter types, methods for setting and retrieving adapters, and handling caching and method delegation.

classes.name: Zend_Translate
classes.description: Main class for managing translation adapters, including setting adapters, caching, and method delegation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Zend_Translate object with specified adapter, data, locale, and options.

methods.name: setAdapter
methods.description: Sets a new translation adapter based on the provided adapter name and data.

methods.name: getAdapter
methods.description: Returns the current translation adapter instance.

methods.name: setCache
methods.description: Sets a cache object to be used by all Zend_Translate instances.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Delegates method calls to the underlying adapter if the method exists.
